description: This Java class 'XmlWidgetVisitor' generates XML representations of widget models for the OFBiz framework. It implements visitor methods for various widget components, producing their corresponding XML elements with attributes and sub-elements.

classes.name: XmlWidgetVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses widget model components and outputs corresponding XML elements, attributes, and nested widgets as part of generating an unformatted XML representation of widget configurations.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Overloaded methods for visiting different widget model components, converting them into XML snippets.

methods.name: visitModelForm
methods.description: Generates XML for a widget form, including its properties, actions, fields, and update areas.

methods.name: visitSubWidgets
methods.description: Helper method to iterate and accept visitor for sub-widgets collection.

methods.name: visitUpdateAreas
methods.description: Helper method to output XML for a list of update area configurations.
